verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail is a SaaS virtual-mailbox service. Its marketing says it offers its own APIs that keep the mailbox in sync with other tools, which suggests mail could be accessed programmatically without the web UI. The claim is a single generic line with no detail on how automated or CI use would work. Missing for 10: API reference documentation, authentication method for unattended or headless use (API keys or service accounts), a CLI or SDK, documented CI or automation workflows, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
